<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="az">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>DigiBaku — Admin</title>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>

<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{
  min-height:100vh;
  background:#05070b;
  color:#fff;
  font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif
}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.hidden{display:none!important}

#loadingScreen{
  min-height:100vh;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  color:#6da8ff;
  font-size:18px
}
#app{display:none;min-height:100vh}
.container{
  width:min(1180px,94%);
  margin:auto;
  padding:25px 0 50px
}

.topbar,.panel-head,.dashboard-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:15px
}
.topbar{margin-bottom:25px}
.logo{font-size:25px;font-weight:800}
.logo span{color:#168cff}
.admin-text,.panel-subtitle{
  color:#778196;
  font-size:12px
}

.dashboard-title,.new-order-mail,.dash-btn,.card,
.order-item,.product-item,.price-item,.customer-item,
.stat-card,.mini-stat,.setting-row,
.chat-users,.chat-box,.chat-orders{
  border:1px solid #151e2b;
  background:#090d14;
  border-radius:16px
}

.dashboard-title{
  flex:1;
  padding:20px
}
.dashboard-title h1{
  font-size:24px;
  margin-bottom:7px
}
.dashboard-title p{
  color:#778196;
  font-size:13px
}

.new-order-mail{
  width:285px;
  min-height:92px;
  color:#fff;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:13px;
  padding:15px 17px;
  text-align:left;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#07192d,#08111e);
  border-color:#1b5fa7
}
.new-order-mail.has-new{border-color:#168cff}
.mail-icon{
  width:48px;
  height:42px;
  border-radius:12px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  background:#0b2d4e;
  color:#40a7ff;
  font-size:25px
}
.mail-info{flex:1}
.mail-info strong,.mail-info small{display:block}
.mail-info small{
  color:#8290a5;
  font-size:12px;
  margin-top:5px
}
.mail-badge,.dash-badge{
  background:#168cff;
  border-radius:20px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  font-size:11px
}
.mail-badge{
  min-width:28px;
  height:28px;
  padding:0 8px
}

.dashboard-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:13px;
  margin-top:18px
}
.dash-btn{
  min-height:105px;
  color:#fff;
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;

}
.dash-btn:hover{
  border-color:#1f78c7;
  transform:translateY(-2px)
}
.dash-icon{font-size:26px}
.dash-name{
  font-size:14px;
  font-weight:700
}
.dash-badge{
  position:absolute;
  top:10px;
  right:10px;
  min-width:21px;
  height:21px;
  padding:0 6px
}

.panel{display:none}
.panel.active{display:block}
.panel-head{margin-bottom:18px}
.panel-title{
  font-size:22px;
  font-weight:800
}

.back-btn,.secondary-btn,.small-btn{
  border:1px solid #263346;
  background:#0b1119;
  color:#d7deea;
  border-radius:9px;
  padding:9px 12px
}
.card{

}
.card-title{

}
.empty{

  font-size:13px
}

.form-grid{
  display:grid;

  gap:12px
}
.field{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;

}
.field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.field label{

}

input,select,textarea{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid #1a2432;
  background:#060a10;

  border-radius:10px;

}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{
  border-color:#218bff
}
textarea{

}

.primary-btn{

  font-weight:700
}
.danger-btn{
  border:0;
  background:#7d1d2c;

  border-radius:9px;

}
.success-btn{
  border:0;

}

.order-item,.product-item,.customer-item,.price-item{
  padding:14px;
  margin-bottom:9px
}
.order-top,.customer-item,.product-item,.price-head{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px
}
.order-user,.customer-name{
  font-weight:bold;
  font-size:13px
}
.order-email,.customer-email,
.product-info small,.price-key{
  color:#718096;
  font-size:11px;
  margin-top:4px
}
.order-price,.sales-number{
  color:#55b1ff;
  font-weight:bold
}
.order-meta{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:8px;
  margin-top:12px
}
.order-meta span{
  font-size:11px;
  color:#8995a8;
  background:#0d141e;
  padding:6px 8px;
  border-radius:7px
}
.status{
  padding:6px 9px;
  border-radius:7px;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:bold
}
.status-pending{background:#392d0c;color:#f3c95d}
.status-confirmed{background:#102c45;color:#55b7ff}
.status-processing{background:#252052;color:#a999ff}
.status-completed{background:#0b3826;color:#5bdaa1}
.status-cancelled{background:#3b151c;color:#ff8291}

.order-actions,.product-actions,.quick-actions{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:7px;
  margin-top:12px
}

.search-tools{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,1.5fr) 180px 180px auto;
  gap:8px
}
.filter-summary{
  color:#78869a;
  font-size:11px;
  margin-top:10px
}
.warning-card{
  border:1px solid #624d13;
  background:#191408;

  border-radius:13px;
  padding:13px;
  margin-bottom:12px
}
.warning-item{
  font-size:11px;
  color:#bba969;
  margin-top:5px
}

.price-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:10px
}
.price-box{
  background:#060a10;
  border:1px solid #182230;
  border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px
}
.price-box-title{
  color:#78869a;
  font-size:10px;
  margin-bottom:7px
}
.price-box input{
  padding:9px;
  margin-bottom:7px
}
.switch-row{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between
}
.switch{
  width:38px;
  height:20px;
  position:relative
}
.switch input{display:none}
.slider{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  border-radius:20px;
  background:#222d3d
}
.slider:before{
  content:"";
  width:14px;
  height:14px;
  background:#fff;
  border-radius:50%;
  position:absolute;
  left:3px;
  top:3px;
  transition:.2s
}
.switch input:checked+.slider{background:#168cff}
.switch input:checked+.slider:before{
  transform:translateX(18px)
}

.stats-grid,.stats-extra-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:12px
}
.stat-card,.mini-stat{padding:18px}
.stat-value,.mini-stat-value{
  font-size:22px;
  font-weight:800
}
.stat-label,.mini-stat-label{

}
.sales-row{

}

.chat-layout{

}
.chat-users,.chat-box,.chat-orders{overflow:hidden}

}

}
.chat-box{

}
.chat-header,.chat-orders-head{

.messages{

.chat-order-list{

}

}
.profile-stat{

}

}

}
.setting-row{

#toast{
  position:fixed;
  right:20px;
  bottom:20px;
  z-index:9999;
  background:#101722;
  border:1px solid #263548;

  padding:12px 16px;

  font-size:12px;
  opacity:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  transform:translateY(10px);
  transition:.25s
}
#toast.show{
  opacity:1;
  transform:translateY(0)
}

.modal{

<body>

<div id="loadingScreen">DigiBaku Admin yüklənir...</div>

<div id="app">
<div class="container">

<div class="topbar">
  <div class="logo">Digi<span>Baku</span></div>
  <div class="admin-text">Admin panel</div>
</div>

<section id="dashboard">

<div class="dashboard-head">

<div class="dashboard-title">
<h1>İdarəetmə paneli</h1>
<p>DigiBaku xidmətlərini buradan idarə et.</p>
</div>

<button
class="new-order-mail"
id="newOrderMail"
onclick="openPanel('ordersPanel');loadOrders()"
>
<div class="mail-icon">✉</div>
<div class="mail-info">
<strong>Yeni sifariş</strong>
<small id="newOrderText">Yoxlanılır...</small>
</div>
<div class="mail-badge" id="newOrderBadge">0</div>
</button>

<script>

const SUPABASE_URL=
"https://zeknhnkaicqkfzgnvycq.supabase.co";

const SUPABASE_KEY=
"sb_publishable_jHvCp9fXBA_BwFqrXYpwlw_VC6C1OQk";

const supabaseClient=
supabase.createClient(
SUPABASE_URL,
SUPABASE_KEY
);

const ADMIN_EMAIL=
"zahidovorxan989@gmail.com";

let currentUser=null;
let currentChatUser=null;
let currentOrders=[];
let currentOrderFilter="all";
let realtimeChannel=null;
let showArchivedOrders=false;
let siteProducts=[];


const STATUS_NAMES={
pending:"Cavab gözlənilir",
confirmed:"Təsdiqləndi",
processing:"Hazırlanır",
completed:"Hazırdır",
cancelled:"Ləğv edildi"
};


function escapeHtml(v){

return String(v??"")
.replace(/&/g,"&amp;")
.replace(/</g,"&lt;")
.replace(/>/g,"&gt;")
.replace(/"/g,"&quot;")
.replace(/'/g,"&#039;")

}


function escapeJs(v){

return String(v??"")
.replace(/\\/g,"\\\\")
.replace(/'/g,"\\'")
.replace(/\n/g,"\\n")
.replace(/\r/g,"\\r")

}


function cssEscape(v){

return window.CSS?.escape
?CSS.escape(v)
:String(v).replace(/["\\]/g,"\\$&")

}


function formatMoney(v){

return Number(v||0).toFixed(2)

}


function formatBakuDate(v){

if(!v)return"-";

let d=new Date(v);

if(isNaN(d))return"-";

return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
"az-AZ",
{
timeZone:"Asia/Baku",
day:"2-digit",
month:"2-digit",
year:"numeric",
hour:"2-digit",
minute:"2-digit",
hour12:false
}
).format(d)

}


function statusClass(s){

return "status status-"+
String(s||"pending").toLowerCase()

}


function toast(m){

let e=document.getElementById("toast");

e.textContent=m;

e.classList.add("show");

setTimeout(
()=>e.classList.remove("show"),
2500
)

}


function openPanel(id){

document.getElementById("dashboard").style.display="none";

document
.querySelectorAll(".panel")
.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));

let t=document.getElementById(id);

if(t)t.classList.add("active");

if(id==="productsPanel"){
loadSiteProducts();
loadProducts()
}

if(id==="faqPanel"){
loadFaqs()
}

if(id==="pricesPanel"){
loadPrices()
}

window.scrollTo({
top:0,
behavior:"smooth"
})

}


function goDashboard(){

document
.querySelectorAll(".panel")
.forEach(x=>x.classList.remove("active"));

document.getElementById("dashboard").style.display="block";

updateBadges();

window.scrollTo({
top:0,
behavior:"smooth"
})

}


async function checkAuth(){

try{

let {
data,
error
}=await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();

if(error||!data.user){

location.href="https://digibaku.com";

return

}

currentUser=data.user;

if(
!currentUser.email ||
currentUser.email.toLowerCase()!==
ADMIN_EMAIL.toLowerCase()
){

await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();

location.href="https://digibaku.com";

return

}

document.getElementById(
"loadingScreen"
).style.display="none";

document.getElementById(
"app"
).style.display="block";

document.getElementById(
"adminEmail"
).textContent=currentUser.email;

await updateBadges();

populateNewPriceFields();

setupRealtime();

}catch(e){

console.error(e);

location.href="https://digibaku.com"

}

}


async function updateBadges(){

try{

let {
data:orders
}=await supabaseClient
.from("orders")
.select("id,status");

let p=(orders||[])
.filter(x=>x.status==="pending")
.length;

let ob=document.getElementById("ordersBadge");
let nb=document.getElementById("newOrderBadge");
let nm=document.getElementById("newOrderMail");
let nt=document.getElementById("newOrderText");

ob.textContent=p;
ob.classList.toggle("hidden",!p);

nb.textContent=p;

nm.classList.toggle("has-new",!!p);

nt.textContent=p
?p+" yeni sifariş var"
:"Yeni sifariş yoxdur";


let {
data:messages
}=await supabaseClient
.from("messages")
.select("id")
.eq("sender_role","customer")
.eq("is_read",false);

let u=(messages||[]).length;

let mb=document.getElementById(
"messagesBadge"
);

mb.textContent=u;

mb.classList.toggle(
"hidden",
!u
);

}catch(e){

console.error(e)

}

}


async function loadOrders(){

let c=document.getElementById(
"ordersList"
);

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Sifarişlər yüklənir...</div></div>';

let {
data,
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("orders")
.select(
"id,user_id,total,status,created_at,updated_at"
)
.order("created_at",{ascending:false});

if(error){

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Sifarişləri yükləmək mümkün olmadı.</div></div>';

return

}

currentOrders=data||[];

let ids=[
...new Set(
currentOrders
.map(x=>x.user_id)
.filter(Boolean)
)
];

let profiles=[];

if(ids.length){

let r=await supabaseClient
.from("profiles")
.select("id,email,full_name")
.in("id",ids);

profiles=r.data||[]

}

currentOrders=currentOrders.map(
o=>({
...o,
profile:profiles.find(
p=>p.id===o.user_id
)
})
);

renderOrders();

updateBadges()

}


function filterOrders(f){

currentOrderFilter=f||"all";

renderOrders()

}


function clearOrderSearch(){

[
"orderSearch",
"orderDateFrom",
"orderDateTo"
]
.forEach(id=>{

let e=document.getElementById(id);

if(e)e.value=""

});

renderOrders()

}


function archivedIds(){

try{

return JSON.parse(
localStorage.getItem(
"digibaku_archived_orders"
)||"[]"
)

}catch{

return[]

}

}


function isArchived(id){

return archivedIds().includes(
String(id)
)

}


function archiveOrder(id){

let a=archivedIds();

if(!a.includes(String(id)))
a.push(String(id));

localStorage.setItem(
"digibaku_archived_orders",
JSON.stringify(a)
);

toast("Sifariş arxivə keçirildi.");

renderOrders()

}


function restoreOrder(id){

localStorage.setItem(
"digibaku_archived_orders",
JSON.stringify(
archivedIds().filter(
x=>x!==String(id)
)
)
);

toast("Sifariş arxivdən çıxarıldı.");

renderOrders()

}


function toggleArchivedOrders(){

showArchivedOrders=!showArchivedOrders;

renderOrders()

}


function renderOrders(){

let list=[...currentOrders];

let q=(
document.getElementById(
"orderSearch"
)?.value||""
)
.toLowerCase()
.trim();

let from=
document.getElementById(
"orderDateFrom"
)?.value;

let to=
document.getElementById(
"orderDateTo"
)?.value;


if(currentOrderFilter!=="all")
list=list.filter(
x=>x.status===currentOrderFilter
);


if(q)

list=list.filter(o=>
[
o.id,
o.total,
o.profile?.full_name,
o.profile?.email
]
.join(" ")
.toLowerCase()
.includes(q)
);


if(from)

list=list.filter(
o=>new Date(o.created_at)>=
new Date(from+"T00:00:00")
);


if(to)

list=list.filter(
o=>new Date(o.created_at)<=
new Date(to+"T23:59:59")
);


list=list.filter(
o=>showArchivedOrders
?isArchived(o.id)
:!isArchived(o.id)
);


let c=document.getElementById(
"ordersList"
);

if(!list.length){

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Sifariş tapılmadı.</div></div>';

return

}


c.innerHTML=list.map(o=>`

<div class="order-item">

<div class="order-top">

<div>

<div class="order-user">
${escapeHtml(
o.profile?.full_name||
"Müştəri"
)}
</div>

<div class="order-email">
${escapeHtml(
o.profile?.email||""
)}
</div>

</div>

<div class="order-price">
${formatMoney(o.total)} AZN
</div>

</div>


<div class="order-meta">

<span>
ID: ${escapeHtml(o.id)}
</span>

<span>
${escapeHtml(
formatBakuDate(o.created_at)
)}
</span>

<span class="${statusClass(o.status)}">
${escapeHtml(
STATUS_NAMES[o.status]||o.status
)}
</span>

</div>


<div class="order-actions">

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="openOrderChat('${escapeJs(o.user_id)}')"
>
💬 Mesaj
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="showOrderProducts('${escapeJs(o.id)}')"
>
📦 Məhsullar
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="updateOrderStatus('${escapeJs(o.id)}','pending')"
>
Gözləyir
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="updateOrderStatus('${escapeJs(o.id)}','confirmed')"
>
Təsdiq
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="updateOrderStatus('${escapeJs(o.id)}','processing')"
>
Hazırlanır
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="updateOrderStatus('${escapeJs(o.id)}','completed')"
>
Hazır
</button>

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="updateOrderStatus('${escapeJs(o.id)}','cancelled')"
>
Ləğv
</button>

${
showArchivedOrders
?
`<button
class="success-btn"
onclick="restoreOrder('${escapeJs(o.id)}')"
>
Arxivdən çıxar
</button>`
:
`<button
class="danger-btn"
onclick="archiveOrder('${escapeJs(o.id)}')"
>
Arxiv
</button>`
}

</div>

</div>

`).join("")

let s=document.getElementById(
"orderFilterSummary"
);

if(s){

s.textContent=
(showArchivedOrders?"Arxiv: ":"Aktiv: ")+
list.length+
" sifariş";

}

}

/* ===================== MƏRKƏZİ QİYMƏT SİSTEMİ ===================== */

function getPriceMonths(product,priceRow={}){

let months=durationValues(product);

if(months.length)
return [...new Set(months)].sort((a,b)=>a-b);

let detected=[1,2,3,6,12].filter(m=>
(
priceRow[`price_${m}_month`]!==null &&
priceRow[`price_${m}_month`]!==undefined
) ||
(
priceRow[`sale_${m}_price`]!==null &&
priceRow[`sale_${m}_price`]!==undefined
)
);

return detected.length?detected:[1,2,3];

}


function getSiteProductName(p){

return p?.name_az||
p?.name||
p?.name_ru||
p?.name_en||
p?.slug||
p?.product_key||
"Adsız məhsul";

}


async function loadPrices(){

let c=document.getElementById(
"pricesList"
);

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Qiymətlər yüklənir...</div></div>';


let [
productsResult,
pricesResult
]=await Promise.all([

supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.select("*")
.order("created_at",{ascending:true}),

supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.select("*")

]);


if(productsResult.error){

console.error(productsResult.error);

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Sayt məhsulları yüklənmədi.</div></div>';

return

}


if(pricesResult.error){

console.error(pricesResult.error);

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Qiymətlər yüklənmədi.</div></div>';

return

}


siteProducts=
productsResult.data||[];

let prices=
pricesResult.data||[];


if(!siteProducts.length){

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Sayt məhsulu yoxdur.</div></div>';

return

}


let html=[];


siteProducts.forEach(p=>{

let key=
String(p.product_key||"").trim();

if(!key)return;

let r=
prices.find(
x=>String(x.product_key)===key
);

let name=
getSiteProductName(p);


if(!r){

html.push(`

<div class="card">

<div class="empty">

${escapeHtml(name)}

üçün product_prices sətri tapılmadı.

</div>

</div>

`);

return;

}


let months=
getPriceMonths(p,r);


html.push(
renderPriceItem(
{
key,
name,
months
},
r
)
);

});


c.innerHTML=
html.join("")||
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">Qiymət üçün məhsul tapılmadı.</div></div>';

}


function renderPriceItem(p,r){

return `

<div class="price-item">

<div class="price-head">

<div>

<div style="font-weight:bold">
${escapeHtml(p.name)}
</div>

<div class="price-key">
${escapeHtml(p.key)}
</div>

</div>

</div>


<div class="price-grid">

${p.months
.map(m=>
renderPriceBox(
p.key,
m,
r
)
)
.join("")}

</div>


<button
class="primary-btn"
style="margin-top:12px"
onclick="savePrice('${escapeJs(p.key)}')"
>
💾 Qiyməti yadda saxla
</button>

</div>

`;

}


function renderPriceBox(k,m,r){

let n=
r?.[`price_${m}_month`]??"";

let s=
r?.[`sale_${m}_price`]??"";

let a=
!!r?.[`sale_${m}_active`];


return `

<div class="price-box">

<div class="price-box-title">
${m===12?"12 ay":m+" ay"}
</div>

<input
type="number"
step="0.01"
id="${escapeHtml(k)}_${m}_normal"
value="${escapeHtml(n)}"
placeholder="Normal"
>

<input
type="number"
step="0.01"
id="${escapeHtml(k)}_${m}_sale"
value="${escapeHtml(s)}"
placeholder="Endirim"
>

<div class="switch-row">

<span style="font-size:10px;color:#78869a">
Endirim aktiv
</span>

<label class="switch">

<input
type="checkbox"
id="${escapeHtml(k)}_${m}_active"
${a?"checked":""}
>

<span class="slider"></span>

</label>

</div>

</div>

`;

}


async function savePrice(k){

k=String(k||"").trim();

if(!k){

toast("Məhsul açarı tapılmadı.");

return

}


let p=
siteProducts.find(
x=>String(x.product_key||"")===k
);


if(!p){

let {
data,
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.select("*")
.eq("product_key",k)
.limit(1)
.maybeSingle();

if(error||!data){

toast("Məhsul tapılmadı.");

return

}

p=data;

}


let months=
getPriceMonths(p,{});

let u={};


months.forEach(m=>{

let n=
document.getElementById(
`${k}_${m}_normal`
)?.value??"";

let s=
document.getElementById(
`${k}_${m}_sale`
)?.value??"";

let a=
document.getElementById(
`${k}_${m}_active`
)?.checked||false;


u[`price_${m}_month`]=
n===""?null:Number(n);

u[`sale_${m}_price`]=
s===""?null:Number(s);

u[`sale_${m}_active`]=a;

});


let {
data:existing,
error:findError
}=await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.select("product_key")
.eq("product_key",k)
.limit(1)
.maybeSingle();


if(findError){

console.error(findError);

toast("Qiymət sətrini yoxlamaq olmadı.");

return

}


let error;


if(existing){

({error}=await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.update({
...u,
product_name:getSiteProductName(p)
})
.eq("product_key",k));

}else{

({error}=await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.insert({
product_key:k,
product_name:getSiteProductName(p),
...u
}));

}


toast(
error
?"Qiyməti yadda saxlamaq olmadı."
:"Qiymət uğurla dəyişdirildi."
);


if(!error)
loadPrices();

}


/* ===================== SAYT MƏHSUL KATALOQU ===================== */

function durationValues(p){

try{

let a=
Array.isArray(p?.durations)
?p.durations
:JSON.parse(p?.durations||"[]");

return a
.map(
x=>Number(
typeof x==="object"
?x.months
:x
)
)
.filter(Boolean)

}catch{

return[]

}

}


function durationJson(vals){

return vals.map(
months=>({
months:Number(months)
})
)

}


function durationChecks(vals,base){

return [1,2,3,6,12]
.map(m=>`

<label class="duration-chip">

<input
type="checkbox"
class="${base}-duration"
value="${m}"
${vals.includes(m)?"checked":""}
>

${m===12?"12 ay":m+" ay"}

</label>

`).join("")

}

}


function toggleSiteProductEdit(id){

let e=document.getElementById(
"siteEdit_"+id
);

if(e)
e.classList.toggle("open")

}


function selectedDurations(selector){

return [
...document.querySelectorAll(selector)
]
.filter(x=>x.checked)
.map(x=>Number(x.value))
.filter(Boolean)

}


function previewNewSiteImage(){

let url=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteImage"
)?.value.trim();

let img=
document.getElementById(
"newSitePreview"
);

if(!img)return;

if(!url){

img.classList.add("hidden");

img.removeAttribute("src");

return

}

img.src=url;

img.classList.remove("hidden");

img.onerror=()=>{
img.classList.add("hidden")
};

}


function populateNewPriceFields(){

let c=document.getElementById(
"newPriceFields"
);

if(!c)return;

c.innerHTML=
[1,2,3,12]
.map(m=>`

<div class="inline-price">

<small>
${m===12?"12 ay":m+" ay"}
</small>

<input
id="newNormal_${m}"
type="number"
step="0.01"
placeholder="Normal"
>

<input
id="newSale_${m}"
type="number"
step="0.01"
placeholder="Endirim"
>

</div>

`)
.join("")

}


/* ===================== YENİ MƏHSUL ===================== */

async function createSiteProduct(){

let nameAz=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteNameAz"
).value.trim();

let nameRu=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteNameRu"
).value.trim();

let nameEn=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteNameEn"
).value.trim();

let name=
nameAz||nameRu||nameEn;

let key=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteKey"
).value.trim().toLowerCase();

let slug=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteSlug"
).value.trim().toLowerCase();

let category=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteCategory"
).value.trim();

let image=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteImage"
).value.trim();

let descriptionAz=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteDescriptionAz"
).value.trim();

let descriptionRu=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteDescriptionRu"
).value.trim();

let descriptionEn=
document.getElementById(
"newSiteDescriptionEn"
).value.trim();

let description=
descriptionAz||
descriptionRu||
descriptionEn;

let dur=
selectedDurations(
".newSite-duration"
);

let q=
document.getElementById(
"newFaqQuestion"
).value.trim();

let a=
document.getElementById(
"newFaqAnswer"
).value.trim();


if(!name||!key||!slug){

toast(
"Məhsul adı, product key və slug mütləqdir."
);

return

}


if(!dur.length){

toast(
"Ən azı bir müddət seç."
);

return

}


let {
data:existing
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.select("id")
.or(
`product_key.eq.${key},slug.eq.${slug}`
)
.limit(1);


if(existing?.length){

toast(
"Bu product key və ya slug artıq mövcuddur."
);

return

}


let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.insert({

product_key:key,

name,

name_az:nameAz,
name_ru:nameRu,
name_en:nameEn,

description,

description_az:descriptionAz,
description_ru:descriptionRu,
description_en:descriptionEn,

image_url:image,

category,

active:true,

durations:
durationJson(dur),

slug,

updated_at:
new Date().toISOString()

});


if(error){

toast(
"Məhsul əlavə olunmadı: "+
(error.message||"xəta")
);

return

}


let priceRow={
product_key:key,
product_name:name
};


[1,2,3,12].forEach(m=>{

let n=
document.getElementById(
"newNormal_"+m
)?.value||"";

let s=
document.getElementById(
"newSale_"+m
)?.value||"";

priceRow[
`price_${m}_month`
]=
n===""
?null
:Number(n);

priceRow[
`sale_${m}_price`
]=
s===""
?null
:Number(s);

priceRow[
`sale_${m}_active`
]=
s!=="";

});


let {
error:pe
}=await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.upsert(
priceRow,
{onConflict:"product_key"}
);


if(q&&a){

let {
error:fe
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.insert({

product_key:key,

question:q,

answer:a,

language:"az",

active:true,

sort_order:0

});

if(fe)
console.warn(fe)

}


toast(
pe
?
"Məhsul əlavə edildi, amma qiymət sətrində xəta oldu."
:
"Məhsul, qiymət və FAQ mərkəzi sistemə əlavə edildi."
);

clearNewSiteProductForm();

loadSiteProducts();

loadPrices();

}


/* ===================== MƏHSUL REDAKTƏ ===================== */

async function saveSiteProduct(id){

let p=
siteProducts.find(
x=>String(x.id)===String(id)
);

if(!p)return;


let key=
document.getElementById(
"editKey_"+id
).value.trim().toLowerCase();

let slug=
document.getElementById(
"editSlug_"+id
).value.trim().toLowerCase();

let nameAz=
document.getElementById(
"editNameAz_"+id
).value.trim();

let nameRu=
document.getElementById(
"editNameRu_"+id
).value.trim();

let nameEn=
document.getElementById(
"editNameEn_"+id
).value.trim();

let descriptionAz=
document.getElementById(
"editDescriptionAz_"+id
).value.trim();

let descriptionRu=
document.getElementById(
"editDescriptionRu_"+id
).value.trim();

let descriptionEn=
document.getElementById(
"editDescriptionEn_"+id
).value.trim();

let name=
nameAz||nameRu||nameEn;

let u={

name,

name_az:nameAz,
name_ru:nameRu,
name_en:nameEn,

product_key:key,

slug,

category:
document.getElementById(
"editCategory_"+id
).value.trim(),

image_url:
document.getElementById(
"editImage_"+id
).value.trim(),

description:
descriptionAz||
descriptionRu||
descriptionEn,

description_az:descriptionAz,
description_ru:descriptionRu,
description_en:descriptionEn,

durations:
durationJson(
selectedDurations(
".edit_"+cssEscape(
String(id)
)+"-duration"
)
),

updated_at:
new Date().toISOString()

};


let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.update(u)
.eq("id",id);


if(error){

toast(
"Yadda saxlamaq olmadı: "+
(error.message||"xəta")
);

return

}


if(p.product_key!==key){

await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.update({
product_key:key,
product_name:u.name
})
.eq(
"product_key",
p.product_key
);


await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.update({
product_key:key
})
.eq(
"product_key",
p.product_key
);

}else{

await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.update({
product_name:u.name
})
.eq(
"product_key",
key
)

}


toast(
"Məhsul yadda saxlanıldı."
);

loadSiteProducts();

loadPrices();

}


/* ===================== AKTİV / DEAKTİV ===================== */

async function toggleSiteProduct(
id,
active
){

let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.update({
active:!active,
updated_at:new Date().toISOString()
})
.eq("id",id);


if(error){

toast("Status dəyişmədi.");

return

}


toast(
!active
?"Məhsul aktiv edildi."
:"Məhsul deaktiv edildi."
);

loadSiteProducts();

loadPrices()

}

async function deleteSiteProduct(id){

if(
!confirm(
"Bu SAYT məhsulunu silmək istəyirsən?"
)
)return;


let p=
siteProducts.find(
x=>String(x.id)===String(id)
);


let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_products")
.delete()
.eq("id",id);


if(error){

toast(
"Məhsul silinmədi: "+
(error.message||"xəta")
);

return

}


if(p?.product_key){

await supabaseClient
.from("product_prices")
.delete()
.eq(
"product_key",
p.product_key
);


await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.delete()
.eq(
"product_key",
p.product_key
)

}


toast(
"Sayt məhsulu və ona bağlı mərkəzi məlumatlar silindi."
);

loadSiteProducts();

loadPrices()

}

/* ===================== FAQ ===================== */

async function loadFaqs(
productKey=""
){

let c=document.getElementById(
"faqList"
);

if(!c)return;

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">FAQ-lar yüklənir...</div></div>';


let q=supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.select("*")
.order(
"sort_order",
{ascending:true}
)
.order(
"created_at",
{ascending:true}
);


if(productKey)
q=q.eq(
"product_key",
productKey
);


let {
data,
error
}=await q;


if(error){

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">site_faqs cədvəli tapılmadı və ya oxuma icazəsi yoxdur.</div></div>';

return

}


c.innerHTML=
(data||[])
.map(f=>`

<div class="faq-item">

<div class="faq-q">
${escapeHtml(f.question||"")}
</div>

<div class="faq-a">
${escapeHtml(f.answer||"")}
</div>

<div class="site-product-meta">

${escapeHtml(
f.product_key||"ümumi"
)}

·

${escapeHtml(
f.language||"az"
)}

·

${f.active!==false
?"Aktiv"
:"Deaktiv"}

</div>


<div class="faq-actions">

<button
class="small-btn"
onclick="editFaq('${escapeJs(f.id)}')"
>
✏️ Redaktə
</button>


<button
class="${
f.active!==false
?'danger-btn'
:'success-btn'
}"
onclick="toggleFaq(
'${escapeJs(f.id)}',
${f.active!==false}
)"
>
${
f.active!==false
?"Deaktiv et"
:"Aktiv et"
}
</button>


<button
class="danger-btn"
onclick="deleteFaq('${escapeJs(f.id)}')"
>
🗑️ Sil
</button>

</div>

</div>

`)
.join("")
||
'<div class="card"><div class="empty">FAQ yoxdur.</div></div>'

}


async function createFaq(){

let k=
document.getElementById(
"faqProductKey"
).value.trim().toLowerCase();

let l=
document.getElementById(
"faqLanguage"
).value;

let q=
document.getElementById(
"faqQuestion"
).value.trim();

let a=
document.getElementById(
"faqAnswer"
).value.trim();

let s=
Number(
document.getElementById(
"faqSort"
).value||0
);

let active=
document.getElementById(
"faqActive"
).checked;


if(!q||!a){

toast(
"Sual və cavabı doldur."
);

return

}


let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.insert({

product_key:k||null,

language:l,

question:q,

answer:a,

sort_order:s,

active

});


if(error){

toast(
"FAQ əlavə olunmadı: "+
(error.message||"xəta")
);

return

}


toast("FAQ əlavə edildi.");

document.getElementById(
"faqQuestion"
).value="";

document.getElementById(
"faqAnswer"
).value="";

loadFaqs(k)

}


async function editFaq(id){

let {
data,
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.select("*")
.eq("id",id)
.maybeSingle();

if(error||!data){

toast("FAQ tapılmadı.");

return

}

let q=prompt(
"Sual:",
data.question||""
);

if(q===null)return;

let a=prompt(
"Cavab:",
data.answer||""
);

if(a===null)return;

let {
error:updateError
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.update({
question:q,
answer:a
})
.eq("id",id);

if(updateError){

toast("FAQ dəyişdirilmədi.");

return

}

toast("FAQ yadda saxlanıldı.");

loadFaqs(data.product_key||"")

}


async function toggleFaq(id,active){

let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.update({
active:!active
})
.eq("id",id);

if(error){

toast("FAQ statusu dəyişmədi.");

return

}

toast(
active
?"FAQ deaktiv edildi."
:"FAQ aktiv edildi."
);

loadFaqs()

}


async function deleteFaq(id){

if(!confirm("Bu FAQ silinsin?"))
return;

let {
error
}=await supabaseClient
.from("site_faqs")
.delete()
.eq("id",id);

if(error){

toast("FAQ silinmədi.");

return

}

toast("FAQ silindi.");

loadFaqs()

}

/* ===================== STATİSTİKA ===================== */

async function loadStats(){

let [
customersResult,
ordersResult
]=await Promise.all([

supabaseClient
.from("profiles")
.select("id"),

supabaseClient
.from("orders")
.select("*")

]);


let customers=
customersResult.data||[];

let orders=
ordersResult.data||[];


document.getElementById(
"statCustomers"
).textContent=
customers.length;


document.getElementById(
"statOrders"
).textContent=
orders.length;


let completed=
orders.filter(
x=>x.status==="completed"
);

let pending=
orders.filter(
x=>x.status==="pending"
);


let revenue=
completed.reduce(
(a,x)=>a+Number(x.total||0),
0
);


document.getElementById(
"statRevenue"
).textContent=
formatMoney(revenue)+" AZN";


document.getElementById(
"statCompleted"
).textContent=
completed.length;


document.getElementById(
"statPending"
).textContent=
pending.length;


let now=new Date();

let today=
new Date(
now.getFullYear(),
now.getMonth(),
now.getDate()
);

let week=
new Date(today);

week.setDate(
week.getDate()-7
);

let month=
new Date(
now.getFullYear(),
now.getMonth(),
1
);


let todayRevenue=
completed
.filter(
x=>new Date(x.created_at)>=today
)
.reduce(
(a,x)=>a+Number(x.total||0),
0
);

let weekRevenue=
completed
.filter(
x=>new Date(x.created_at)>=week
)
.reduce(
(a,x)=>a+Number(x.total||0),
0
);

let monthRevenue=
completed
.filter(
x=>new Date(x.created_at)>=month
)
.reduce(
(a,x)=>a+Number(x.total||0),
0
);


document.getElementById(
"statTodayRevenue"
).textContent=
formatMoney(todayRevenue)+" AZN";

document.getElementById(
"statWeekRevenue"
).textContent=
formatMoney(weekRevenue)+" AZN";

document.getElementById(
"statMonthRevenue"
).textContent=
formatMoney(monthRevenue)+" AZN";


let sales=
{};

completed.forEach(o=>{

let name=
o.product_name||
o.product_key||
"Məhsul";

if(!sales[name])
sales[name]={
count:0,
total:0
};

sales[name].count++;

sales[name].total+=
Number(o.total||0);

});


let c=document.getElementById(
"salesStatsList"
);

let keys=
Object.keys(sales);

if(!keys.length){

c.innerHTML=
'<div class="empty">Satış statistikası yoxdur.</div>';

return

}


c.innerHTML=
keys.map(k=>`

<div class="sales-row">

<div>

<div style="font-weight:bold">
${escapeHtml(k)}
</div>

<div class="admin-text">
${sales[k].count} satış
</div>

</div>

<div class="sales-number">
${formatMoney(
sales[k].total
)} AZN
</div>

</div>

`).join("")

}


/* ===================== REALTIME ===================== */

function setupRealtime(){

try{

if(realtimeChannel)
supabaseClient
.removeChannel(realtimeChannel);

realtimeChannel=
supabaseClient
.channel("digibaku-admin");

realtimeChannel
.on(
"postgres_changes",
{
event:"*",
schema:"public",
table:"orders"
},
()=>{

updateBadges();

if(
document
.getElementById(
"ordersPanel"
)
.classList.contains("active")
)
loadOrders();

}
)
.on(
"postgres_changes",
{
event:"*",
schema:"public",
table:"messages"
},
()=>{

updateBadges();

if(
document
.getElementById(
"messagesPanel"
)
.classList.contains("active")
&&
currentChatUser
)
loadChatForUser(
currentChatUser
);

}
)
.on(
"postgres_changes",
{
event:"*",
schema:"public",
table:"product_prices"
},
()=>{

if(
document
.getElementById(
"pricesPanel"
)
.classList.contains("active")
)
loadPrices();

}
)
.on(
"postgres_changes",
{
event:"*",
schema:"public",
table:"site_products"
},
()=>{

if(
document
.getElementById(
"productsPanel"
)
.classList.contains("active")
)
loadSiteProducts();

if(
document
.getElementById(
"pricesPanel"
)
.classList.contains("active")
)
loadPrices();

}
)
.subscribe();

}catch(e){

console.error(e)

}

}


/* ===================== ÇIXIŞ ===================== */

async function logout(){

await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();

location.href=
"https://digibaku.com";

}


/* ===================== BAŞLAT ===================== */

checkAuth();

</script>
